$comment: Verified engineering footprint. Measured with the GitHub API on `measured_on` by scripts/discover_repositories.py --write-footprint: for every repository the account can access (owned + collaborator), commits on the DEFAULT BRANCH whose GitHub author login is the profile owner (login match; bot and other-login commits excluded; each SHA counted once) in the window below. Private repositories contribute to the aggregates only; no private name is stored. Update by re-measuring, never by hand.
languages_note: Share of code by bytes across owned repositories, public and private
method_note: Default-branch commits with author login match; includes 12 pull-request merge commits authored by the owner; the public count equals GitHub's public commit contributions for the same window (76).
